input: Buy noise-canceling earplugs for the open-plan office

gold.taskTitle: Buy Noise-Canceling Earplugs for Open-Plan Office
gold.taskDescription: Research and purchase a suitable pair of noise-canceling earplugs to use in a noisy open-plan office environment.

questions.title: Do you need disposable foam plugs or reusable ones?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants single-use disposable earplugs or durable reusable ones for daily office use.

questions.title: What is your budget for this purchase?
questions.description: Understand the price range the user is comfortable spending, from budget options to premium custom-fit earplugs.

questions.title: Do you need to hear colleagues or block all sound?
questions.description: Determine if the user needs to remain partially alert to conversations and announcements or wants maximum noise isolation.

questions.title: Will you wear these for hours at a stretch?
questions.description: Understand the typical duration of use per day, as this heavily affects comfort and fit requirements.

questions.title: Do you have any known ear sensitivity or fit issues?
questions.description: Find out if the user has had discomfort with standard earplug sizes or materials in the past.

questions.title: Where do you prefer to buy — online or in a store?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred purchasing channel so the plan can direct toward the right retailer or platform.

questions.title: How soon do you need them for the office?
questions.description: Establish the urgency of the purchase to factor in shipping times or the need for same-day in-store buying.
